- Mathematical and computational modelling and algorithm development
- Modern application building

positions.title: Development Manager/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Application development with C# and C++
- Mathematical and geometric algorithm building
- .Net and Wpf development
- Toolpath development
- Python scripting
- Integration with databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- implementing mathematical models and geometric operations
- object-oriented development with modern C++ in Visual Studio
- prototyping with Python and JavaScript
- agile development with Git version control
- robotic path planning

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description:
- numerical simulations of condensed matter systems: implement computational modelling of large quantum systems
- statistical analysis and verification of numerical models
- experimental work on condensed matter systems: transport experiments on thin films I fabricated and characterized (AFM, Raman, SEM , etc)

positions.title: Physics Instructor (Teaching Assistant)
positions.description:
- TA for 11 physics courses, including introductory classes and classes for physics seniors
- for 3 semesters served as managing TA for large courses
- developed and executed curricula for interactive sessions

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: While getting my MA, I was a TA for several quarters.
